name: Arjun Patel
household: Lives alone in a shared flat
psychographics: Values convenience over brand loyalty; constantly scans for the best deal on groceries and phone plans.
current_solutions: Uses JioPhone for basic calls, Google Pay for UPI transactions, and BigBasket for grocery delivery when the weekly budget allows.
frustration: Tried to book an Ola bike at 8:45 PM near Andheri; the app showed 'no drivers available' and charged ₹120 cancellation fee anyway, leaving him stranded.
decision_style: Compares at least three price points on Google before buying; often postpones non-essential purchases for 2-3 weeks.
voice: Blunt and pragmatic; mixes Hindi words like 'bas' and 'yaar' into English sentences, short clauses, quick to point out failures.
